content: Jointly training both the sequential encoder $e_{\mathit {seq}}$, and the syntactic encoder $e_{\mathit {syn}}$ can be expensive, due to the large number of parameters involved. To reduce cost, we initialize our sequential cwrs $h$, using pretrained embeddings from ELMo-transformer. Once initialized as such, the encoder is fine-tuned to the data likelihood objective (§SECREF5). This results in a staged parameter update, which reduces training duration by a factor of 10 in our experiments. We discuss the empirical effect of this approach in §SECREF20.
